h: Mbappé scores twice as Real Madrid beat Barcelona 2-1 at Camp Nou
p: Kylian Mbappé scored a late winner in the 87th minute to complete a brace and give Real Madrid a 2-1 win at Camp Nou. It ended Barcelona's winning run and was Madrid's first league win at the ground since 2021. Mbappé has now scored eight goals in his first seven El Clásico matches.
more: He has passed Lionel Messi's tally from his first seven meetings with Madrid.
The result tightens the title race.
